name: Uz
overview: Uz is a male biblical figure identified as the son of Nahor, as recorded in Genesis 22:20-21. There is no tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical in nature.
namesAndTitles: The name Uz appears as a proper name in the Scriptures without a given meaning or divine origin noted in Genesis 22:21. It is simply recorded as his personal name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Uz as a son of Nahor, making him part of the extended family of Abraham. He is listed alongside Milcah as Nahor's offspring in Genesis 22:21. No further family relationships are detailed.
scriptureSignificance: Uz's significance lies in his place within the genealogy of Nahor, Abraham's brother, situating him within the broader narrative of God's covenant family. While the text does not elaborate on his personal actions, his mention helps trace the lineage and connections among the patriarchal families. This genealogical detail underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving His people through generations.
